q.en: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I am tired."
q.as: Indirect speech লৈ সলনি কৰক: He said, "I am tired."

options.en: He said that he was tired.
options.as: He said that he was tired.

options.en: He said that I am tired.
options.as: He said that I am tired.

options.en: He says that he is tired.
options.as: He says that he is tired.

options.en: He said that he is tired.
options.as: He said that he is tired.

explanation.en: In indirect speech the present 'am' changes to the past 'was' and 'I' changes to 'he'.
explanation.as: Indirect speech ত present 'am' এ past 'was' লৈ সলনি হয় আৰু 'I' এ 'he' লৈ সলনি হয়।
